Response-shape fixtures for the Binance Spot Test Network REST API
(https://testnet.binance.vision/api), following the official docs at
https://developers.binance.com/en/docs/products/spot/testnet/rest-api
for /v3/order, /v3/openOrders, /v3/myTrades, /v3/account, /v3/exchangeInfo,
/v3/ticker/price and /v3/time. Values are synthetic.
